Notes_Limits.Note: All values come from the Mars Exploration Checklist PDF (11 papers). Nothing was added from outside the PDF. Workbook is limited to AP-1, AP-8, AP-9, Gale and Jezero.
Site_Facts holds values tied to one site. Mars_Wide_Facts holds values that apply to all sites or come from a landing site (Viking, Phoenix, Gale). Join on Item_No.
Site_Item_Coverage shows, for every site and every checklist item, whether the PDF gives site-specific data. 'Mars-wide only' means use Mars_Wide_Facts for that item.
Come from specific landing sites (Viking, Phoenix, Gale), not from the Arcadia/Amazonis candidate sites.
From a 2019 review citing Appelbaum and Flood (1990).
The lab gas mix Schuerger et al. used to simulate Mars, not a new measurement.
Mashal's summary says 16 regions identified; the rest of that paper says 23. (Not used for the sites kept here.)
Only AP-1, AP-8 and AP-9 have coordinates in the PDF. Gale and Jezero are blank, so maps will not plot them.
Value_Min/Value_Max hold numbers parsed from the text. Mission round-trip dose 1.01 Sv stored as 1010 mSv.
